news.title: Applications Open for Butler University’s Master of Science in Nursing–Entry-to-Practice Program
news.summary_en: Butler University is accepting applications for its new Master of Science in Nursing–Entry-to-Practice (MSN-ETP) program, giving individuals with non-nursing bachelor’s degrees a new pathway to pursue a meaningful career in nursing. The inaugural cohort will begin classes in fall 2027. Designed specifically for career changers, the five-semester hybrid program combines online coursework, on-campus
news.author: Katie Palmer Wharton '14
